mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level directly increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, reducing present value and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals severe economic distress, triggering market panic followed by a rebound as policy responses materialize, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day forward return when UNRATE > 5.0 not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and UNRATE above 4.0% indicates a dual shock to monetary policy and labor market, causing heightened recession risk and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day forward return when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND UNRATE > 4.0 not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months), the federal funds rate level directly compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return during FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals economic contraction, leading to market overselling followed by rebound as recession fears peak, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 20-day returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400 (thousands of units) indicates housing market collapse, triggering economic uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day forward return when HOUST < 1400 not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in HOUST below 1400 and RSAFS below 650000 (millions of dollars) indicates systemic housing sector collapse, causing widespread economic concern and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day forward return when HOUST < 1400 AND RSAFS < 650000 not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below 20200 billion dollars (2017 chained) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 as predictor of 20-day returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation p-value > 0.05.
